title: 领益智造董事长：苹果涨价影响有限，已转向手机笔记本
speaker: Yvonne

segments.en: And then we also, because we have around a hundred thousand employees around the world, outside of China, we have a thirty thousand.
segments.zh: 我们在全球有约10万员工，中国以外有3万。

segments.en: Then the whole factory, we also have a huge amount of data that we are going to share with all the industry that get together.
segments.zh: 整个工厂有大量数据，将与整个行业共享。

segments.en: And then we believe we can do a lot of achievement to these pros.
segments.zh: 我们相信能取得很多成就。

segments.en: We just got news that Apple is hiking the prices of its iPad and MacBooks on the back of those memory shortage.
segments.zh: 刚得到消息，苹果因内存短缺提高iPad和MacBook价格。

segments.en: So I'm wondering as a major supplier, how big of a hit is that going to be for your demand and for your margins?
segments.zh: 作为主要供应商，这对需求和利润率影响多大？

segments.en: Actually, we knew that earlier because we are very the co-supplier of the industry. So we knew that earlier.
segments.zh: 实际上我们早就知道，因为我们是行业联合供应商。

segments.en: And then we already kind of shift our capability and the case of it, the case of it into phone, into notebook.
segments.zh: 我们已经将能力转向手机和笔记本。

segments.en: That two one is still grow.
